faq: Can Loopky fully replace Anki?
For most learners, yes. Check first if you rely on audio files, LaTeX, custom card templates or FSRS.
Does Loopky use FSRS?
No. Each grade button has a fixed interval that you set, from 1 to 365 days.
Is it free?
Yes. No ads, no subscription, and open source under the MIT license.
Is there an iPhone app?
Loopky is on Android now. The iOS app is built and coming soon.

Yes. Speak mode uses your device's speech recognition to grade the answer. Loopky does not store or upload the recording.
Is it good for Japanese, Chinese or Korean?

How is it different from Duolingo?

Yes. Export them as .apkg with media. Text, images and cloze come across; audio and review history do not.

faq: How many cards should I study a day?
Start with 10 to 20 new cards and all your due reviews. Loopky's default goal is 20 new cards.
Is it better than rereading notes?
Yes. Research on spacing and testing shows recall at spaced intervals beats rereading and cramming.
What algorithm does Loopky use?
Fixed intervals per button: under 10 minutes, then 1, 3 and 7 days by default, each adjustable up to 365.

faq.title: Loopky FAQ: price, Anki import, privacy and sign in
faq.desc: Answers about Loopky, the free flashcards app: price, Android and iOS, tablets, Anki import, spaced repetition, text to speech, sharing, privacy and sign in.
faq.blurb: Price, platforms, privacy, Anki and sign in.
faq.lead: What it costs, where it runs, what it imports, and where your data goes.
faq.heroAlt: Loopky's Today screen with the daily queue
faq: What is Loopky?
A free flashcards app with spaced repetition. You make or import decks, study a few minutes a day, and each card comes back right before you forget it.
Is it really free?
Yes. No price, no subscription, no ads and no in-app purchases. The code is open source under MIT.
Where does it run?
Android 10 and later, on phones and tablets. The iOS app is coming soon. On computers, a command line tool manages decks.
Can I import Anki decks?
Yes: .apkg with text, images and cloze, plus .txt, .csv and pasted lists. Audio, LaTeX and review history are not imported.
How does it schedule cards?
Fixed intervals per button: under 10 minutes for Again, then 1, 3 and 7 days by default, each adjustable up to 365.
Can it read cards aloud?
Yes, in 35 languages and variants, and Speak mode checks your pronunciation.
Can I share decks?
Yes. Publish a deck and share its link. Others can follow it or clone it.
Are my decks private?
No. Published decks are public and searchable. Your study progress stays under your own key.
How do I sign in?
With a Pubky key through the Pubky Ring app, or by creating an account in the app. No email or password.
Does Loopky track me?
No. No analytics, no telemetry, no crash reporting, no ads.
Does it work offline?
Partly. Offline reviews are saved and sent later, but loading decks needs a connection.
Can an AI make decks for me?
Yes. The command line tool is built for AI agents like Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini.
